gen-flavors-gf-jaldi: Flavors is all stubby, towering letters and mischief. Jaldi, the sans-serif body, is brushed on with tight spacing and a gaping c, so the shouting up top gets a sturdy partner.
gen-flavors-gf-krona-one: Rounded-nib swagger, stubby and plainly loud. Flavors loses its punch if made small, while Krona One, a loosely spaced sans with lowercase built like cast-iron capitals, holds its ground.
gen-flavors-gf-major-mono-display: Flavors stands tall and whimsical, its diagonals carrying as much heft as the stems. Major Mono Display, a monospace drawn like neon glass tubing with roomy sidebearings, would read slowly and precisely over many lines.
gen-flavors-gf-martian-mono: Stubby, loud and a bit whimsical. Make Flavors small and it loses its muscle, whereas Martian Mono, a monospace with fixed-width code letters and loose spacing, stays open and spread out.
gen-flavors-gf-mitr: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors stands on towering lowercase and round letters with no stress tilting them anywhere. Mitr, a sans, reads smooth and compact, its lowercase nearly touching cap height.
gen-flavors-gf-momo-trust-display: Flavors twists its letters like bent tubing, with towering lowercase and stout diagonals. Momo Trust Display, a sans-serif with drifting letters and generous x-height, makes reading feel spacious and clean.
gen-flavors-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar, a sans with compressed ascenders, sits quietly beneath Flavors, whose every glyph keeps one flat line weight. Whimsical shouting meets compact, quiet restraint, and the gap is the whole appeal.
gen-flavors-gf-mukta-vaani: Commanding and whimsical, Flavors fattens its crossbars to match its stems and lets the lowercase tower overhead. Mukta Vaani, a sans with a high-waisted lowercase, supplies the quiet counterweight.
gen-flavors-gf-narnoor: Marker-nib swagger: Flavors towers over the line, indifferent to stroke direction. And Narnoor, a sans-serif with short ascenders above big bowls, reads smoothly, line after line, without fuss.
gen-flavors-gf-secular-one: Towering lowercase is the whole personality up top. Flavors does the shouting best, while Secular One, the plain sans with a dominant midsection and unmodulated lines, does the explaining.
